name: 0024 - emergency stop button box
summary: Red mushroom emergency-stop button on a grey and black square enclosure, yellow legend disc, four corner fastener wells and one pale cable gland.
assumptions: Shape inferred by the interactive assistant from 16 sampled frames; no standalone model API request was made.
No measurements or known metric reference were supplied. Dimensions are uncalibrated nominal estimates based on proportions and object-size priors, not a metric scan.
The object is represented as one rigid assembly. No articulation or internal mechanism is inferred.
Materials use approximate flat PBR colors. Lighting is not calibrated and image textures are not recovered.
Mass and friction are simulation assumptions; these are not determined by the visible video dynamics.
Nominal enclosure width and depth are 75 mm. The red head is roughly 42 mm across; total nominal height is 80 mm.
The button is fixed in its observed raised state; electrical function, travel and push/twist behavior are not implemented.
Emergency-stop lettering, embossed arrows, fine knurling and screw-well depth are omitted in this first geometric candidate.
The cable gland opening is modeled, but it terminates at the solid enclosure approximation; no internal electronics are reconstructed.
Nominal mass is assumed to be 0.20 kg; friction 0.5 and restitution 0 are assumptions.
Second candidate was refined by comparing renders to video crops; no calibrated image registration or metric accuracy score is claimed.
